headline: Zenith Bank Awards ₦190 Million to African Innovators at Tech Fair
summary: Zenith Bank Plc awarded ₦190 million to 13 winners across three innovation competitions at its virtual tech fair, reinforcing support for African technology leaders.
why: Zenith Bank Plc is a major Nigerian multinational financial service provider offering banking and financial services across Africa.

impacts.name: Zenith Bank
impacts.why: Corporate sponsorship and tech funding initiatives reflect institutional brand investment and community engagement.
